features.expected_output: mnemos.hermetic_run_environment.v1 manifest and mnemos.gate_hermeticity_audit.v1 report with sandbox_root, environment_hash, outside_write_count, formal_state_diff, repo_state_diff and per-command evidence
features.data_landing: all HOME/Mnemos/database/wiki/XDG/temp/pycache/artifact/log/report paths under one sandbox_root
features.success_standard: every owned path is inside sandbox_root; default credential set is empty; diagnostics are read-only; outside_write_count=0; formal_state_diff=[]; repo_state_diff=[]; CI Linux/macOS/Windows system tests use the same argv runner without shell-specific temp/env syntax; all selected commands have accepted return codes
features.failure_or_degradation: nonempty/reused roots, unimplemented profiles, path escape, formal/repo mutation, missing explicit hermetic environment, hidden credential inheritance or command failure return nonzero; formal runtime backlog remains a separate runtime truth and is never cleared to make the boundary green

features.feature_name: relation_evidence 单一 schema authority 与显式迁移
features.expected_input: fresh database or one of the two recognized prior relation_evidence schemas; explicit apply requires a stopped daemon, zero NULL/blank evidence_type rows, and a backup directory
features.expected_output: mnemos.relation_evidence_schema.v1 report with classification, semantic DDL hash, registry version/hash, columns/notnull/default/pk, foreign key, index, row/null counts, migration_required, backup integrity and row-count preservation
features.data_landing: canonical relation_evidence table plus mnemos_schema_registry component row in knowledge_graph.db; apply backup in the caller-selected backup directory
features.success_standard: exactly one production DDL owner; both constructor orders yield the same canonical hash; existing constructors validate before all other DDL; actual columns/defaults/FK/index hash equals registry; row count and integrity are preserved; unknown or ambiguous rows never receive guessed values
features.failure_or_degradation: unregistered prior schema, old RelationManager defaults, NULL/blank evidence_type, missing index, damaged/stale registry, unknown columns/FK/index or hash mismatch blocks writers and strict gates with an explicit reconciliation action; migration exceptions roll back and retain the verified backup

features.feature_name: 满分总验收 strict gate
data_dependencies: canonical 62-gate manifest and certificate receipts, including the independently declared Phase 5 production-readonly and frozen failure-contract gates
features.expected_input: developer or release agent runs the full strict real-api release gate from a clean committed worktree without only/skip selectors; non-release smoke runs may use selectors but are non-certifying
features.expected_output: mnemos.full_score_gates.v2 JSON/Markdown, mnemos.full_score_gate_manifest.v1 expected/selected/executed/omitted sets, full Git/clean state, per-gate receipts and stdout/stderr hashes, release_eligible decision and independent verifier result
features.data_landing: /tmp/mnemos-full-score-gates/<timestamp>/ by default, or an absent/empty explicit --output-dir used as the sandbox_root; all reports/logs/run state remain under that root
features.success_standard: canonical 62-gate expected=selected=executed, omitted=[], clean full Git commit, all required receipts pass including schema.relation_evidence.strict, the independently declared contracts.persona_runtime_effectiveness, contracts.blindspot_asset_boundaries and contracts.phase5_failure_contracts gates, three quality zero-closure gates, docs.asset_manifest.strict required Desktop profile, contracts.cognitive_action_effects, contracts.cognitive_calibration_lineage, contracts.cognitive_event_dispatch, contracts.evidence_graph_direction, contracts.cognitive_search and model_call_ledger.static, health strict is fully ok, run_environment outside_write_count=0/formal_state_diff=[], certificate and every stdout/stderr hash verify, certifying=true and release_eligible=true
features.failure_or_degradation: strict real-api only/skip, unknown/empty selectors, dirty worktree, legacy v1, partial/mock run, manifest/receipt/artifact tamper, timeout, omitted gate, required failure, nonempty root or formal-state mutation are non-certifying/nonzero; diagnostic partial may exit 0 only with release_eligible=false
